mainTopic: רב and שמואל on the rulings of רבי יוסי, the טומטום and חליצה, and the status of an אנדרוגינוס for forbidden relations and for קדשים.
overview: The amud opens by finishing the list of cases where רב and שמואל rule like רבי יוסי. The last case is a vine spread over a friend's grain, where רבי יוסי says a person cannot forbid what is not his. The גמרא then asks about cases where only one of the two gave a ruling. שמואל is shown to reject רבי יוסי on אנדרוגינוס and on grafting. רב's view on קושי ends in תיקו. On קידוש, רב הונא's report wins: רב did not follow רבי יוסי. Next, the גמרא discusses רבי יהודה's view that an opened טומטום is a סריס, and the opinion of רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה that it is only a doubt; רבא spells out the practical differences for חליצה. It then turns to רב's ruling that relations with an אנדרוגינוס bring סקילה in both places, which follows רבי סימאי's reading of 'משכבי אשה' against the רבנן. Finally, רב חסדא limits רבי אליעזר's view that an אנדרוגינוס is a full male, proving from a ברייתא about bird offerings that it does not apply to קדשים.

steps.title: A person cannot forbid what is not his
steps.stepSummary: These are the closing words of רבי יוסי's opinion: a person has no power to forbid an item that does not belong to him.
steps.simpleTranslation: A person cannot make forbidden something that is not his.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes quoting רבי יוסי's reason in the case of a man whose vine spread over his friend's grain, which would normally make the grain forbidden as כלאים. It belongs to the list of cases where the הלכה follows רבי יוסי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since the grain does not belong to him, his words have no effect on it. In this case שמואל also rules like רבי יוסי. That finishes the list and sets up the questions that follow.

keyTerms.meaning: makes something forbidden (here, through the איסור of כלאי הכרם)
an item that does not belong to him

steps.whyThisMatters: This is a basic rule for רבי יוסי: a person's actions cannot create an איסור on property that belongs to someone else.

phrases.english: A person cannot render forbidden
an item that is not his.
phrases.notes: This ends רבי יוסי's view on a vine spread over a friend's grain. The grain doesn't become forbidden as כלאים, because it isn't his.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֵין אָדָם אוֹסֵר דָּבָר שֶׁאֵינוֹ שֶׁלּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the list of cases where the הלכה follows רבי יוסי, which began earlier on the daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A person cannot forbid an item that he does not own.

steps.title: What did שמואל hold about an אנדרוגינוס?
steps.stepSummary: רב ruled like רבי יוסי about an אנדרוגינוס, but we have no ruling from שמואל on it. What was his view?
steps.simpleTranslation: A question was asked: about an אנדרוגינוס, what did שמואל say?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a new question. It is setting up a search for שמואל's opinion on a case where only רב's ruling was recorded.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב and שמואל each listed cases where the הלכה follows רבי יוסי. The אנדרוגינוס case shows up only in רב's list. So we do not know whether שמואל disagrees or simply did not mention it.

keyTerms.meaning: a question was raised before them (the חכמים)
a person with both male and female features

phrases.english: A dilemma was raised before them:
As for a hermaphrodite, what did Shmuel say?

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: בְּאַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס מָה לִי אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the lists are done, the גמרא asks about a case that only רב mentioned.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does שמואל also rule like רבי יוסי that an אנדרוגינוס is a category of its own?

steps.title: A ברייתא cannot stand against a משנה
steps.stepSummary: שמואל told רב ענן that a ברייתא does not stand up against a משנה. So he does not follow רבי יוסי's ברייתא about an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: שמואל said to רב ענן, "The ברייתא does not stand before the משנה."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by quoting something שמואל said. That quote shows he rejects רבי יוסי's view on an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי's view, that an אנדרוגינוס is a creature of its own, appears in a ברייתא. The משנה treats the case differently. שמואל's rule that a ברייתא gives way to a משנה means he does not rule like רבי יוסי here.

keyTerms.meaning: a teaching of the תנאים that is not in the משנה
in front of; when compared with

phrases.english: Come and hear,
as Shmuel said to Rav Anan:
The baraita is not to be relied upon in the presence of the mishna.
phrases.notes: The ברייתא here is the one where רבי יוסי says an אנדרוגינוס is a creature of its own.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע, דְּאָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל לְרַב עָנָן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question in step 2.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: שמואל does not rule like רבי יוסי about an אנדרוגינוס, because he follows the משנה over the ברייתא.

steps.title: What did שמואל hold about grafting?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks the same kind of question about הרכבה (grafting before שביעית).
steps.simpleTranslation: About grafting, what did שמואל say?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a second question in the same pattern. It is setting up another quote from שמואל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here too, one list has a ruling on grafting but we have nothing from שמואל. The question is whether he follows רבי יוסי on how long before שביעית a person may still graft.

keyTerms.meaning: grafting one plant onto another

phrases.english: Grafting, what did Shmuel say?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The same kind of question as step 2, now about a different case.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does שמואל rule like רבי יוסי about how long before שביעית one may graft?

steps.title: Teach it as thirty-three days
steps.stepSummary: שמואל told רב ענן to teach the opinion that requires thirty-three days. That shows he does not follow רבי יוסי here.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: שמואל told רב ענן, "Teach like the one who says thirty-three."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers again with something שמואל said to רב ענן. He chose the thirty-three-day opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The thirty-three-day opinion is not רבי יוסי's view. Since שמואל told רב ענן to teach it, we learn that on grafting שמואל rules against רבי יוסי.

keyTerms.meaning: like the one who says

phrases.english: Come and hear,
as Shmuel said to Rav Anan:
Teach in accordance with the one who said thirty-three.
phrases.notes: He means thirty-three days before ראש השנה of שביעית, the last point when one may still plant or graft.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע, דַּאֲמַר לֵיהּ שְׁמוּאֵל לְרַב עָנָן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question in step 4.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: שמואל follows the thirty-three-day opinion, not רבי יוסי.

steps.title: What did רב hold about difficult labor?
steps.stepSummary: Now the question turns around: שמואל ruled like רבי יוסי about קושי (difficult labor). What did רב hold?
steps.simpleTranslation: About difficult labor, what did רב say?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a third question, this time about רב instead of שמואל. It is setting up the final result.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This time שמואל's list has the case, and רב's does not. The גמרא wants to know whether רב also follows רבי יוסי here.

keyTerms.meaning: difficult, drawn-out labor before giving birth

phrases.english: Protracted labor, what did Rav say?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The same pattern as before, but now asking about רב.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does רב agree with שמואל that the הלכה follows רבי יוסי about קושי?

steps.title: The question stays open
steps.stepSummary: No source answers the question about רב, so it remains unresolved: תיקו.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let it stand.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finds no proof for רב's view on קושי and leaves the question open.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first two questions were answered with quotes from שמואל. For רב, the גמרא has no such quote, so it ends with תיקו.

keyTerms.meaning: let it stand; the question stays unresolved

steps.whatToRemember: שמואל does not follow רבי יוסי on אנדרוגינוס (a ברייתא gives way to a משנה) or on grafting (thirty-three days). רב's view on קושי stays unresolved: תיקו.
steps.confusionAlert: תיקו does not mean the הלכה goes against רבי יוסי. It only means the גמרא could not find out what רב held.

phrases.english: Let it stand.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the question in step 6 without an answer.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: We do not know whether רב follows רבי יוסי about קושי.

steps.title: What did רב hold about קידוש?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what רב held about רבי יוסי's ruling on קידוש.
steps.simpleTranslation: About קידוש, what did רב say?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now asks about another one of רבי יוסי's rulings, קידוש, and wants to know whether רב followed it. This question sets up the next few steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: קידוש is the case from step 1: a man spreads his vine over someone else's grain, and רבי יוסי says he cannot forbid what is not his. That case was on שמואל's list, not רב's. So the גמרא asks whether רב also follows רבי יוסי here.

keyTerms.meaning: Making something forbidden (here, grain becoming forbidden as כלאים under someone's vine)

phrases.english: Proscription, what did Rav say?
phrases.notes: קידוש here means grain becoming forbidden as כלאים. It is the vine-over-grain case from step 1, where שמואל follows רבי יוסי.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the תיקו about קושי, the גמרא asks the same question about another topic.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Did רב rule like רבי יוסי about קידוש?

steps.title: רב יוסף: רב did not follow רבי יוסי
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף cites רב הונא in the name of רב: the הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יוסף said: Come and hear, for רב הונא said in the name of רב: The הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף answers the question with a report from רב הונא that רב said the הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This seems to settle it: רב rejected רבי יוסי's view on קידוש. The source comes from רב הונא, who was רב's student.

keyTerms.meaning: The הלכה is not (like this opinion)

phrases.english: Rav Yosef said: Come and hear,
as Rav Huna said that Rav said:
The halakha is not like Rabbi Yosei.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 8.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: According to רב הונא, רב ruled that the הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.

steps.title: אביי: Another report says רב did follow רבי יוסי
steps.stepSummary: אביי challenges רב יוסף with רב אדא's report that רב ruled like רבי יוסי.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said to him: Why did you rely on that report? Rely on this one! For רב אדא said in the name of רב: The הלכה is like רבי יוסי.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי pushes back. He points out that there is a second report of what רב said, and it says the opposite.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now we have two students quoting רב in opposite ways. אביי asks why רב יוסף chose one report over the other. The next step gives the reason.

keyTerms.meaning: What did you see? (Why choose this over that?)
Rely on

phrases.english: Abaye said to him:
What did you see that you relied on this?
Rely on this instead!
As Rav Adda said that Rav said:
The halakha is like Rabbi Yosei.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the source brought in step 9.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב יוסף's reliance on רב הונא's report
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: There is a different report of רב's words that says the opposite, so there is no reason to prefer the first report.

steps.title: רב הונא's report wins
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains that רב הונא is the main voice of רב's school, so his report is preferred.
steps.simpleTranslation: When it says 'they say in the school of רב,' who is that? רב הונא. And רב הונא said: The הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers אביי. רב הונא is the person meant whenever we hear 'the school of רב,' so his version of רב's words is preferred.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since רב הונא was רב's leading student, his tradition is more trusted than רב אדא's. So the conclusion stays: רב did not rule like רבי יוסי about קידוש.

keyTerms.meaning: They say in the school of רב
Who is it?

steps.whatToRemember: About קידוש, we go with רב הונא's report: רב held that the הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.

phrases.english: 'They say in the school of Rav' — who is it?
Rav Huna.
And Rav Huna said: The halakha is not like him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers אביי's challenge from step 10.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Ranking of sources: the leading student's tradition is preferred
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Both reports are equally strong, so we cannot know what רב held.
steps.terutzMaskana: רב הונא represents the school of רב, so his report wins: the הלכה is not like רבי יוסי.

steps.title: רבי אמי: The טומטום of בירי had seven children
steps.stepSummary: רבי אמי challenges רבי יהודה from a real case of a טומטום who was opened up and later fathered seven children.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: A טומטום, and so on. רבי אמי said: What will רבי יהודה do with the טומטום of בירי, who was sat on a chair, was torn open, and fathered seven sons?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes רבי יהודה's opinion in the משנה about a טומטום, and רבי אמי challenges it with a real story.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה holds that a טומטום who is opened up and found male is treated like a סריס, unable to have children, so he cannot do חליצה. But the טומטום of בירי was opened up and then had seven children. That seems to prove רבי יהודה wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: A person whose body is covered so we cannot tell if male or female
Was torn open
A chair or seat

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda says: A tumtum, etc.
phrases.notes: This quotes the משנה: a טומטום who was opened up and found male may not do חליצה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Ami said:
What will Rabbi Yehuda do
with the tumtum of Biri,
who they sat on a chair, and he was torn open,
and he fathered seven sons!

steps.triggerLanguage: מַאי עָבֵיד לֵיהּ רַבִּי יְהוּדָה לְטוּמְטוּם דְּבֵירֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new topic: the משנה's opinion of רבי יהודה about a טומטום.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יהודה's view that an opened טומטום is like a סריס
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A real case shows that an opened טומטום had children, so he was not a סריס.

steps.title: רבי יהודה: Check where those children came from
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה would answer that the children were not really his.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי יהודה would tell you: Go check where his children came from.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers for רבי יהודה. He would say the seven children were not really fathered by that man.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה does not accept the story as proof. He suspects the children came from someone else, so his rule that an opened טומטום is a סריס still stands.

keyTerms.meaning: Go around, check
Where are they from?

phrases.english: And Rabbi Yehuda would say to you:
Go check about his children, where they are from.
phrases.notes: He means the children were probably not really this man's.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defends רבי יהודה against רבי אמי's challenge.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rejecting the facts of the challenge
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The seven children prove an opened טומטום can have children.
steps.terutzMaskana: The children were not really his, so רבי יהודה's rule stands.

steps.title: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה: A טומטום may not do חליצה
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה says a טומטום may not do חליצה, since he might be opened and found to be a סריס חמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was taught: רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה says: A טומטום may not do חליצה, since he might be torn open and be found a סריס חמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא with a different opinion about a טומטום and חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Unlike רבי יהודה, who treats an opened טומטום as surely a סריס, רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה only says he might turn out to be one. This is a doubt, not a certainty.

keyTerms.meaning: Do חליצה
Someone born unable to have children

phrases.aramaic: תַּנְיָא, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר:
phrases.english: It was taught: Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda, says:
A tumtum may not do halitza,
since perhaps he will be torn open
and be found to be a eunuch from birth.

steps.triggerLanguage: תַּנְיָא, רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a second opinion on the same subject of a טומטום and חליצה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A טומטום may not do חליצה, because he might turn out to be a סריס חמה.

steps.title: Is every opened טומטום male?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the ברייתא assumes that an opened טומטום will be male.
steps.simpleTranslation: Is that to say that everyone who is torn open turns out male?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא questions the wording of the ברייתא, which only mentions the chance he will be a סריס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A טומטום who is opened might turn out to be female. The ברייתא's wording seems to skip that, as if he must be male.

keyTerms.meaning: Is that to say?
Male

phrases.english: Is that to say that everyone who is torn open is male?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the wording of the ברייתא in step 14.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: It ignores the possibility that the טומטום is female.

steps.title: Two doubts: female, or a male סריס
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא explains that the ברייתא means two doubts: he may be female, and even if male he may be a סריס חמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: This is what he means: Perhaps he will be torn open and found female; and even if he is found male, perhaps he will be found a סריס חמה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rereads the ברייתא so that it includes both possibilities.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A woman cannot do חליצה, and neither can a סריס חמה. So there are two separate reasons to worry, and the ברייתא means both.

keyTerms.meaning: This is what he means
Female

phrases.english: This is what he means:
Perhaps he will be torn open and found to be female,
and even if he is found to be male,
perhaps he will be found to be a eunuch from birth.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the wording question of step 15.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the ברייתא to include an unstated case
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא assumes every opened טומטום is male.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ברייתא means two doubts: maybe female, and even if male, maybe a סריס חמה.

steps.title: What is the difference between the two opinions?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what practical difference there is between רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the difference between them?
steps.whatsHappening: Both opinions say a טומטום does not do חליצה, so the גמרא asks what practical difference there is between them. This sets up רבא's answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה treats the opened טומטום as surely a סריס. רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה treats him only as a doubt. The גמרא wants to know when this changes the outcome.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the difference between them?

phrases.english: What is the difference between them?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Compares the opinion in the משנה with the ברייתא's opinion.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The practical difference between רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה.

steps.title: רבא: Two practical differences
steps.stepSummary: רבא: they differ on whether the טומטום's חליצה disqualifies the other brothers, and whether he must do חליצה when there are no other brothers.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: The difference between them is whether he disqualifies when there are other brothers, and whether he must do חליצה when there are no other brothers.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא gives the answer: two practical cases where the two opinions lead to different rulings.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי יהודה, the טומטום is surely a סריס, so his חליצה means nothing and he never needs to do it. For רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה it is a doubt, so his חליצה does disqualify the other brothers, and if there are no other brothers he must do חליצה to be safe.

keyTerms.meaning: To disqualify
Where there are other brothers
There is a difference between them

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהודה: an opened טומטום is surely a סריס, so his חליצה does nothing. רבי יוסי ברבי יהודה: it is only a doubt, so his חליצה can disqualify, and with no other brothers he must do חליצה.
steps.confusionAlert: Both opinions agree that a טומטום should not do חליצה in the first place. The argument is only about what happens if he does, or if he is the only brother.

phrases.english: Rava said:
Whether he disqualifies where there are other brothers,
phrases.notes: If he did חליצה anyway, does that stop the other brothers from doing יבום?

phrases.english: and whether he must do halitza where there are no other brothers,
that is the difference between them.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 17.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: They differ on whether the טומטום's חליצה disqualifies the other brothers, and on whether he must do חליצה when he is the only brother.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows how treating something as a certainty versus a doubt changes the practical הלכה.

steps.title: רב: liability for an אנדרוגינוס in both places
steps.stepSummary: Through a chain of four teachers, רב rules that one who has forbidden relations with an אנדרוגינוס is liable to סקילה in either of his two places.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב שמואל בר יהודה said in the name of רבי אבא, the brother of רבי יהודה בר זבדי, who said in the name of רב יהודה, who said in the name of רב: For an אנדרוגינוס, one is liable to סקילה because of him in two places.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new topic with a ruling from רב, passed down through several teachers. One who has relations with an אנדרוגינוס gets סקילה whether it was in the male way or the female way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אנדרוגינוס has both male and female features. רב treats both of them as places that bring the full punishment of משכב זכר. The rest of the sugya tests this ruling.

keyTerms.meaning: A person with both male and female features
Stoning, the death penalty given for משכב זכר
From two places, meaning in either the male or the female way

phrases.english: Rav Shmuel bar Yehuda said

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַבִּי אַבָּא אֲחוּהּ דְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה בַּר זַבְדִּי
phrases.english: Rabbi Abba, brother of Rabbi Yehuda bar Zavdi, said
Rav Yehuda said that Rav said:
For a hermaphrodite, one is liable to stoning on his account,
from two places.
phrases.notes: He means either the male way or the female way. Both bring the punishment.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic, moving from חליצה of a טומטום to forbidden relations with an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: One is liable to סקילה for relations with an אנדרוגינוס in either the male or the female place.

steps.title: Challenge from רבי אליעזר: only the male way
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא of רבי אליעזר says one is liable for an אנדרוגינוס only in the male way, and exempt in the female way. This contradicts רב.
steps.simpleTranslation: They raised an objection: רבי אליעזר said, for an אנדרוגינוס one is liable to סקילה as for a male. When is this said? In his male way. But in his female way, one is exempt!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רב's ruling with a ברייתא. רבי אליעזר says the female way of an אנדרוגינוס does not bring סקילה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב said both places count. רבי אליעזר counts only the male place, because the אנדרוגינוס is treated 'like a male' here. This looks like a direct contradiction of רב.

keyTerms.meaning: Like a male
The male part or male way
The female part or female way

phrases.english: They raised an objection:
Rabbi Eliezer said:
For a hermaphrodite, one is liable to stoning on his account as for a male.
In what case is this said?
Through his male way,
but through his female way, he is exempt!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רב's ruling from step 19.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב's ruling that both places bring סקילה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא says that the female place brings no liability, which contradicts 'משתי מקומות.'

steps.title: רב follows רבי סימאי
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that רב follows a different תנא, רבי סימאי, who also says both places bring סקילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב said his ruling following this תנא, as a ברייתא teaches: רבי סימאי says, for an אנדרוגינוס one is liable to סקילה in two places.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends רב. He is not arguing with the ברייתא on his own, because he is following רבי סימאי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is a disagreement among תנאים. רבי אליעזר limits liability to the male way, and רבי סימאי includes both ways. רב simply sides with רבי סימאי, so the challenge goes away.

keyTerms.meaning: He said it following this תנא

phrases.english: He stated it in accordance with this tanna,
as it is taught: Rabbi Simai says:
For a hermaphrodite, one is liable to stoning on his account
from two places.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge in step 20.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Attributing the ruling to a different תנא (פלוגתא דתנאי)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רב's ruling seemed to go against every תנאי source.
steps.terutzMaskana: רב follows רבי סימאי, who disagrees with רבי אליעזר.

steps.title: What is רבי סימאי's reason?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of רבי סימאי's view that both places bring liability.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the reason of רבי סימאי?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why רבי סימאי holds this. It is setting up the next step, which brings a פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now that רב depends on רבי סימאי, the גמרא wants to see the basis for his view. The question is about the source, and it is not an attack.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?

phrases.english: What is the reasoning of Rabbi Simai?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the view brought in step 21.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The scriptural basis for liability in both places of an אנדרוגינוס.

steps.title: The plural 'lyings' points to an אנדרוגינוס
steps.stepSummary: רבא brings an explanation from בר המדורי. The פסוק says 'משכבי אשה' in the plural, so it speaks of a 'male' who has two ways of lying, and that is an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: בר המדורי explained it to me. The פסוק says 'And with a male you shall not lie the lyings of a woman.' Which male has two kinds of lying? You must say this is an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives רבי סימאי's source. It reads the plural word 'משכבי' as pointing to a male who has two ways, which is an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An ordinary male has only one way. The plural 'lyings' shows that the פסוק is speaking about someone with two, and that both of them bring סקילה. This is why רבי סימאי counts both places.

keyTerms.meaning: He explained it to me
'The lyings of a woman' (plural)
You must say, meaning this is the only possible answer

phrases.english: Rava said:
Bar Hamedurei explained it to me:
“And you shall not lie with a male the lyings of a woman,”

phrases.aramaic: אֵי זֶהוּ זָכָר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ שְׁנֵי מִשְׁכָּבוֹת —
phrases.english: which male has two kinds of lying?
You must say this is a hermaphrodite.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רָבָא: בַּר הַמְדּוּרֵי אַסְבְּרַהּ לִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 22.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The plural 'משכבי' teaches about a male with two ways, the אנדרוגינוס, and makes both of them liable.
steps.whatToRemember: רבי סימאי learns from the plural 'משכבי אשה' that both places of an אנדרוגינוס bring סקילה.

steps.title: How the רבנן read the פסוק
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן agree that the פסוק speaks of an אנדרוגינוס, but the words 'את זכר' limit liability to the male way only.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the רבנן? Even though he has two kinds of lying, the פסוק says 'with a male.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains how the רבנן, who disagree with רבי סימאי, deal with his proof. They point to the words 'את זכר' in the same פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The רבנן accept that an אנדרוגינוס has two ways. But since the פסוק says 'with a male,' only relations in the male way bring סקילה. That fits רבי אליעזר's ruling from step 20.

keyTerms.meaning: Even though
It is written

phrases.english: And the Rabbis?
phrases.notes: This is a short question: how do the רבנן answer רבי סימאי's proof?

phrases.aramaic: אַף עַל גַּב דְּאִית בֵּיהּ שְׁנֵי מִשְׁכָּבוֹת —
phrases.english: Even though he has two kinds of lying,
“with a male” is written.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבָּנַן, אַף עַל גַּב דְּאִית בֵּיהּ שְׁנֵי מִשְׁכָּבוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing reading of the same פסוק used in step 23.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: 'את זכר' limits liability to the male way of the אנדרוגינוס.
steps.confusionAlert: Both sides agree that the פסוק speaks of an אנדרוגינוס. They argue only about whether the female way also brings סקילה.

steps.title: Where do the רבנן learn the case of an ordinary male?
steps.stepSummary: If the רבנן use the פסוק for an אנדרוגינוס, where do they learn the basic איסור with an ordinary male?
steps.simpleTranslation: And the רבנן, from where do they learn the case of an ordinary male?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a follow-up question. If the פסוק is used up on the אנדרוגינוס, where is the source for the plain case of משכב זכר?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since 'את זכר' was used to limit the אנדרוגינוס case, the basic איסור with an ordinary male seems to have lost its source. The גמרא asks for one.

keyTerms.meaning: An ordinary male, just a male alone
From where do they learn it?

phrases.english: And the Rabbis, from where do they derive an ordinary male?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A follow-up on the reading given in step 24.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for the איסור of משכב זכר with an ordinary male.

steps.title: From the word 'woman'
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן learn the case of an ordinary male from the word 'אשה' in the פסוק.
steps.simpleTranslation: From 'a woman.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the word 'אשה' in the פסוק is the source for an ordinary male.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The phrase 'lyings of a woman' teaches the plain איסור with any male. That leaves 'את זכר' free to teach about the אנדרוגינוס.

keyTerms.meaning: Woman, a word from the פסוק

phrases.english: From “a woman.”

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 25.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The word 'אשה' is the source for the איסור with an ordinary male.

steps.title: Where do they learn a woman in an unnatural way?
steps.stepSummary: Since 'אשה' was used for an ordinary male, where do the רבנן learn liability for a forbidden woman in an unnatural way?
steps.simpleTranslation: With a woman in an unnatural way, from where do they learn it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks one more follow-up question. The word 'אשה' is now used up, so where is the source for a woman שלא כדרכה?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The רבנן read this פסוק as speaking about an אנדרוגינוס, and they used the word 'אשה' for an ordinary male. So they still need a source showing that a forbidden woman brings liability even in an unnatural way.

keyTerms.meaning: Not in her usual way, meaning an unnatural way

phrases.english: With a woman in an unnatural way, from where do they derive it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A follow-up caused by the answer in step 26.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The source for liability with a forbidden woman in an unnatural way.

steps.title: From the extra 'and'
steps.stepSummary: The רבנן learn it from the extra letter ו, 'and,' in 'ואשה.'
steps.simpleTranslation: From 'and a woman.'
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the extra 'ו' adds the case of a woman in an unnatural way.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The letter ו is read as adding something more. This way every part of the פסוק has its own lesson in the view of the רבנן.

keyTerms.meaning: 'And a woman,' where the extra ו adds another case

steps.whatToRemember: For the רבנן: 'את זכר' teaches the male way of an אנדרוגינוס, 'אשה' teaches an ordinary male, and the extra ו teaches a woman in an unnatural way. For רבי סימאי, the plural 'משכבי' makes both places of an אנדרוגינוס liable.

phrases.english: From “and a woman.”
phrases.notes: The extra letter ו at the start of the word adds one more case.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 27.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The extra ו in 'ואשה' teaches liability for a woman in an unnatural way.

steps.title: A hermaphrodite is not a full male in every law
steps.stepSummary: רב שזבי in the name of רב חסדא says that רבי אליעזר did not treat an אנדרוגינוס as a full male for every law. If he did, a hermaphrodite animal would become sanctified as a male קרבן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב שזבי said in the name of רב חסדא: רבי אליעזר did not say for every law that an אנדרוגינוס is a full male. If you say he did, then an אנדרוגינוס animal that is consecrated would become holy.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new statement that puts a limit on רבי אליעזר's view that an אנדרוגינוס is a real male.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier in the סוגיא, רבי אליעזר treated relations with an אנדרוגינוס like relations with a male. רב חסדא says this applies only to that law. It cannot apply to קדשים, because there a hermaphrodite animal would then count as a male and become sanctified, and that is not the הלכה.

keyTerms.meaning: A hermaphrodite, a person or animal with both male and female organs
A proper, full male
Not for everything, not in every respect
Consecrated animals, set aside as קרבנות

steps.confusionAlert: רב חסדא is not saying that רבי אליעזר changed his mind. He is saying the 'full male' rule has limits and does not reach every area of הלכה.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב שֵׁזְבִי אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא:
phrases.english: Rav Shezvi said that Rav Chisda said:
Not for every law did Rabbi Eliezer say
that a hermaphrodite is a full male,
phrases.notes: This points back to רבי אליעזר's earlier view that relations with an אנדרוגינוס are punished the same as with a male.

phrases.english: for if you say so,
then with consecrated animals, it would become holy.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב שֵׁזְבִי אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: לֹא לַכֹּל אָמַר רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from how the רבנן derive their sources to a new limit on רבי אליעזר's view.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי אליעזר's ruling that an אנדרוגינוס is a full male does not apply to every law. It does not apply to sanctifying animals.

steps.title: How do we know a hermaphrodite animal is not sanctified?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source that a hermaphrodite animal does not become sanctified.
steps.simpleTranslation: And from where do we know that it does not become holy?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks for proof of רב חסדא's claim. This question sets up the ברייתא that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב חסדא's argument depends on the fact that a hermaphrodite animal does not become holy. The גמרא wants a source for that fact, especially one that shows רבי אליעזר himself holds it.

keyTerms.meaning: And from where do we know?
Becomes holy or sanctified

phrases.english: And from where do we know that it does not become holy?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source behind the claim in step 29.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: A source showing that a hermaphrodite animal does not become sanctified, according to רבי אליעזר.

steps.title: A ברייתא about birds unfit for the altar
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא lists birds that cannot be offerings, including a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס. If their necks are pinched, they count as unslaughtered carcasses and make a person impure when he eats them.
steps.simpleTranslation: As the Sages taught: A bird used for bestiality, one set aside for idolatry, one that was worshipped, one given as a harlot's payment, one that was the price of a dog, and a טומטום and a hermaphrodite all make garments impure when they reach the throat.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins its answer by quoting a ברייתא. The first opinion lists birds that are unfit for the altar, and it includes a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: מליקה, killing a bird by pinching its neck, only works for a bird that is fit to be a קרבן. Any other bird killed this way is a נבלה, and eating a kosher bird's נבלה makes a person impure. Since the first opinion includes a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס on this list, it treats them as unfit for the altar.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal or bird used for bestiality
Set aside for idol worship
Payment given to a harlot
The price received for a dog
One whose gender cannot be known because the organs are covered
The throat, where swallowing happens

phrases.english: As the Sages taught:
a bird used for bestiality, one set aside for idolatry, and one that was worshipped
and a harlot's payment and the price of a dog
and a tumtum and a hermaphrodite
make garments impure when they reach the throat.
phrases.notes: Swallowing a dead kosher bird makes the person, and the clothes he is wearing, טמא.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts answering the question of step 30 by quoting a ברייתא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The ברייתא's first opinion treats a hermaphrodite bird as unfit for the altar. It sets up the next part, where רבי אליעזר disagrees.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר: 'male and female' leaves out a hermaphrodite
steps.stepSummary: רבי אליעזר says a hermaphrodite bird is fit for the altar. His reason is that a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס are left out only where the תורה says 'male and female,' and it does not say that about birds. This shows that for animals, where 'male and female' is written, he does leave them out.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי אליעזר says: A טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס bird do not make garments impure at the throat. For רבי אליעזר would say: Wherever 'male and female' is stated, you leave out a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס. But for a bird, since 'male and female' is not stated, you do not leave them out.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the second half of the ברייתא. רבי אליעזר's reasoning proves that he does not treat an אנדרוגינוס animal as a male for קרבנות.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For a bird, רבי אליעזר holds that a hermaphrodite is fit for the altar, so pinching its neck works and it is not a נבלה. His reason shows the general rule: where the תורה says 'male and female,' as it does for animal offerings, an אנדרוגינוס is left out. So in קדשים a hermaphrodite animal is not a full male, which is exactly what רב חסדא said.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Male and female', words the תורה uses for animal offerings
Leaves out, excludes
A bird
Since, because

steps.whatToRemember: According to רבי אליעזר, wherever the תורה says 'male and female,' a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס are left out. So a hermaphrodite is not a full male for animal offerings, even though it counts as a male for the איסור discussed earlier.
steps.confusionAlert: רבי אליעזר's lenient ruling about birds does not mean he treats a hermaphrodite as a male. It is fit for the altar only because the תורה never mentions gender for bird offerings.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says:
a tumtum and a hermaphrodite
do not make garments impure when they reach the throat.
For Rabbi Eliezer would say:
Wherever 'male' and 'female' is stated,
you leave out a tumtum and a hermaphrodite from among them.

phrases.aramaic: וְעוֹף, הוֹאִיל וְלֹא נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה
phrases.english: But a bird, since 'male and female' is not stated about it,

phrases.aramaic: אִי אַתָּה מוֹצִיא טוּמְטוּם וְאַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס מִבֵּינֵיהֶם.
phrases.english: you do not leave out a tumtum and a hermaphrodite from among them.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: טוּמְטוּם וְאַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס אֵין מְטַמְּאִין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the ברייתא begun in step 31 and gives the actual proof.
steps.raayaObject: רב חסדא's claim that רבי אליעזר does not treat an אנדרוגינוס as a full male for קדשים.
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי אליעזר's rule in the ברייתא: wherever 'male and female' is stated, a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס are left out.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that the status of an אנדרוגינוס can change from one area of הלכה to another, depending on how the תורה words each law.

steps.title: רב נחמן בר יצחק opens another supporting ברייתא
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן בר יצחק says there is another ברייתא that teaches the same limit on רבי אליעזר's view, and he begins to quote it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב נחמן בר יצחק said: We too learned this in a ברייתא: רבי אליעזר says:
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up another proof. רב נחמן בר יצחק starts to quote a ברייתא, and the quote continues in the next lines.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The phrase 'we too learned' means a תנאי source also teaches this point. It adds support for רב חסדא's limit on רבי אליעזר's view.

keyTerms.meaning: We too learned it, meaning a תנאי source also says this

phrases.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said:
We too learned this:
Rabbi Eliezer says:

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק: אַף אֲנַן נָמֵי תְּנֵינָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second supporting source for רב חסדא's statement, after the proof in step 32.
steps.raayaObject: רב חסדא's limit on רבי אליעזר's view that an אנדרוגינוס is a full male.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא quoting רבי אליעזר, which continues in the next lines.
